sources.name: ISANS - Immigrant Services Association of Nova Scotia
sources.notes: Confirmed live 2026-08-26 - WordPress + The Events Calendar. Atlantic Canada's largest settlement agency (17,000+ clients/yr). Feed returns on-site/online computer training, job search workshops, CSPI, Job Seekers Hub circles etc. - real dated, recurring programming, good practical volume.

sources.name: Dalhousie University Events (LiveWhale)
sources.notes: events.dal.ca runs LiveWhale Calendar - same platform as Calgary's UCalgary/Mount Royal (kind ical). The earlier note said 'no ical export' but it tried the wrong paths (/live/ics/*, /calendar.ics); the working route is /live/ical/events/upcoming (confirmed 2026-09-10, 105 VEVENTs). This is the whole Dal campus calendar - no group filter for the International Centre works (tried /group/international-centre etc, all 0) - so it relies on keyword scoring to surface International Centre postings (drop-in advising, board games, career weeks) out of the campus noise, same as Calgary.

sources.name: Halifax Public Libraries
sources.notes: Runs BiblioCommons - a generic `bibliocommons` parser was added 2026-09-09 (reads the SSR-embedded Redux state, 2,627 events confirmed live) after finding the real backend structure (also unlocked Vancouver Public Library the same day). Filters out Kids/Preschooler/Teen-audience events using the platform's own structured audience facets, same idea as Communico's `ages` field.

sources.name: YMCA of Greater Halifax/Dartmouth - YREACH Settlement
sources.notes: Provincial YMCA settlement program (orientation, integration support, employment navigation, youth conferences, Iftar dinner). Site is WordPress but /wp-json/tribe/events/v1/events 404s - no Events Calendar plugin active. No other feed found - probe until a manual event or a different route is confirmed.

sources.name: NSCC (Nova Scotia Community College) - Events
sources.notes: Runs on a Microsoft IIS/.NET (ASP.NET) custom events system, not a recognized platform - no JSON/REST/ical route found on a first pass 2026-08-26. Content gap for now; NSCC International's specific event announcements would need hand-entry.

sources.name: Saint Mary's University - International Centre

Small liberal-arts college federated with Dalhousie; worth re-probing if the events widget's backend can be identified.

sources.name: Downtown Halifax Business Commission
sources.notes: Drupal 11 site, no JSON:API route for events found; /rss.xml exists but is the generic site feed (stale blog posts from 2022), not events-specific. Downtown festivals (Halifax Fringe, Nocturne) hand-entered in manual_events from this org's own event listing page and Nocturne Halifax's own site.

sources.name: Halifax Regional Municipality - Events
sources.notes: Drupal site (confirmed via meta generator) but /jsonapi/node/event 404s - content type name differs and wasn't identified on a first pass 2026-08-26. Re-probe the JSON:API discovery document if this city gets a second pass.

sources.name: HalifaxEvents.ca
sources.notes: Unblocked 2026-09-10 with the new supabase_events parser. Community what's-on aggregator (concerts/festivals/markets, scrapes Eventbrite etc.) on Supabase; reads straight off the public PostgREST API GET oxngzjrkqsmhstkiyllz.supabase.co/rest/v1/events?start_date=gte.<d>&start_date=lte.<d>. The api_key here is the site's own PUBLIC anon JWT (role:anon, shipped in its JS bundle; Supabase gates data via row-level security, not key secrecy) - safe to commit, expires 2091. ~70 events/quarter, ~13 free; aggregator times are junk (music bingo stamped 02:00) so the parser trusts date-only. NOT in TICKETED_KINDS - the ~57 paid concerts lean on MIN_SCORE rather than a blanket pass. status filter keeps only 'approved'.

sources.name: New in Halifax (Halifax Immigration Partnership newcomer events)
sources.notes: The city's official centralized newcomer-events listing (run by the Halifax Immigration Partnership / HRM), has real dated event pages (e.g. /events/sicam-maritime-ponnonam-2026/) but is not WordPress+tribe (404 on the REST route) - looks Drupal-flavoured; no feed route identified on a first pass. High-value target for a future custom parser given it's purpose-built for this audience.

sources.name: ISMC Halifax (International Student Ministries Canada)

The two events visible on the page during the 2026-08-26 pass (Spring Fitness Jul 11, Dollar Lake Provincial Park Aug 1) had already passed by build time, evidence the page isn't kept current - left with an empty manual event list rather than fabricating forward dates; re-check for fall programming.

sources.notes: Welcoming students since 1988 (1871 Seldon St, near Dalhousie/King's); offers international students a light meal after every Sunday 10am service during the school year - standing weekly program, no dated feed. Per the no-recurring-events rule, left with an empty manual event list.

sources.notes: Added 2026-11-02 must-do sweep: the City's own annual tree-lighting ceremony at Grand Parade was missing from this city's board. halifax.ca itself 403s to automated fetches (WebFetch and a bare request both blocked), so the 2026-11-28 date comes from a third-party Nova Scotia tourism listing only, not the organizer's own page - flagged verify, confirm on halifax.ca or via the City's social media before drafting. 2025's edition ran 6-7pm at Grand Parade, 1770 Barrington St.
